companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company pages to scrape. Accepts full URLs (https://www.linkedin.com/company/hubspot/), a posts URL, or just the slug (hubspot).
companyUrls.title: Company URLs or Slugs

cookie.description: Kept for backward compatibility with older saved tasks. The actor is 100% cookieless; any value here is ignored.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie (optional, not needed)

datePosted.description: Keep only posts published within this window. Applied to each post's real publish date.
datePosted.title: Posted Within

hydratePosts.description: Open each post's public page for the full text, exact publish time, top comments and media. Turn off for a faster, lighter run.
hydratePosts.title: Fetch Full Post Details

includeDocumentDetails.description: For document (PDF/PPTX) posts, also return the original PDF link, page images and the per-page text transcript.
includeDocumentDetails.title: Include Document Details

includeEmployeePosts.description: The public company page mixes a few featured employee posts into its recent feed. Turn this on to include them; off returns the company's own posts (including its showcase/sub-brand pages) only.
includeEmployeePosts.title: Include Employee Posts

includeIndexedPosts.description: Also search the public web index for older company-authored posts. This finds more posts than the company page shows, but coverage depends on the search index.
includeIndexedPosts.title: Include Indexed Posts (deeper history)

includeReactionBreakdown.description: Also return the per-reaction-type breakdown and the repost (share) count when LinkedIn serves the richer public layout. Slightly slower.
includeReactionBreakdown.title: Include Reaction Breakdown

includeReposts.description: Whether to include reposts (posts the company reshared from someone else).
includeReposts.title: Include Reposts

language.description: Preferred content language used when requesting LinkedIn pages.
language.title: Language

maxPostsPerCompany.description: Maximum posts to return per company. LinkedIn itself stops a company's post history at 500 posts and one year; deeper older posts are reachable only through the public search index.
maxPostsPerCompany.title: Max Posts Per Company

minComments.description: Skip posts with fewer than this many comments.
minComments.title: Minimum Comments

minReactions.description: Skip posts with fewer than this many reactions.
minReactions.title: Minimum Reactions

mode.description: What to scrape. "Auto" uses the targets you provide; the actor picks the right pipeline automatically.
mode.title: Mode

monitorMode.description: Return only posts that were not returned by a previous run with the same settings. Useful for scheduled monitoring.
monitorMode.title: Monitor Mode (new posts only)

postTypes.description: Which post media types to keep. Leave empty to keep every type.
postTypes.title: Post Types

postUrls.description: Specific LinkedIn post links to extract (any format: /posts/...-activity-..., share, ugcPost, or /feed/update/urn:li:...). Used in the "Specific post URLs" mode.
postUrls.title: Post URLs

postedAfter.description: Only posts published on or after this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO date-time.
postedAfter.title: Posted On or After

postedBefore.description: Only posts published on or before this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO date-time.
postedBefore.title: Posted On or Before

sortBy.description: How to order the returned posts. Recent = newest first, Popular = most reactions first.
sortBy.title: Sort By
